data.name: Exit.Intro
data.value: Export everything your department put into Training: courses, question banks, records, attempts and certificates.

data.name: Exit.LapsedNotice
data.value: The LMS add-on is not active. Exports keep working: your records and content stay yours.

data.name: Exit.Scope.FullHelp
data.value: Courses with their versions, lessons and media, question banks with answer keys, assessment answers, lesson plans, skill sheets, requirements, plans, and every record.

data.name: Exit.Scope.RecordsOnlyHelp
data.value: Learning records, enrollments, assessment scores, certificates, members and categories as CSV, plus xAPI statements. No course content and no answer keys.

data.name: Exit.IncludeMedia
data.value: Copy hosted videos into the zip (otherwise the zip lists download links)

data.name: Exit.LinkHelp
data.value: The export is built in the background. Its download link works for {0} days.

data.name: Exit.KeysWarning
data.value: A full export contains your question banks with their answer keys and learners' answers. Keep it private.

data.name: Exit.Queued
data.value: The export was queued. This page shows when it is ready.

data.name: Exit.Error.TooManyActive
data.value: Two exports are already being built. Wait for one to finish.

data.name: Exit.Error.NotAuthorized
data.value: Only the department's owner and administrators can export training data.

data.name: Exit.Error.NotReady
data.value: That export is not ready yet.

data.name: Exit.Error.Expired
data.value: That export's download link has expired. Start a new export.

data.name: Exit.FormatHelp
data.value: The zip holds manifest.json with the count of every entity and a checksum of every file. CSV files are UTF-8; times are UTC.

data.name: Scorm.VideoNotIncluded
data.value: This video is not included in the package.

data.name: Ce.Intro
data.value: Training hours and CE / CPD files for any regulator, professional body or employer, plus US files: CAPCE, state CE offices and a state-ready roster.

data.name: Ce.LapsedNotice
data.value: The LMS add-on is not active: files can still be built from your records, but the settings cannot be changed.

data.name: Ce.Disclaimer
data.value: Resgrid builds the files; it does not submit them and is not an accreditor. Check each file before you upload it to a regulator, professional body or other reporting body.

data.name: Ce.IncludeFormer
data.value: Include removed, disabled and hidden members

data.name: Ce.PreviewCount
data.value: {0} rows in the file; the first {1} are shown.

data.name: Ce.NoHeaderRow
data.value: This layout has no header row; the headings above are for reference only.

data.name: Ce.SettingsIntro
data.value: Provider numbers for the US files, and which certification types hold the license or registration numbers the files need.

data.name: Ce.Set.CapceProviderName
data.value: CAPCE provider name (as entered on courses)

data.name: Ce.Set.IdentifiersHelp
data.value: The files read these numbers from each member's certifications of the chosen type: the number, the area as the state, province or region, the type as the level, and the expiry date.

data.name: Ce.Set.LicenseType
data.value: License or registration certification type (state, province or regulator)

data.name: Ce.Saved
data.value: The CE / CPD reporting settings were saved.

data.name: Ce.AddonRequired
data.value: Changing the CE / CPD reporting settings needs an active LMS add-on.

data.name: Ce.ColumnsIntro
data.value: Choose the heading, the value and the format of each column.

data.name: Ce.ColumnsCustom
data.value: Your department's own columns are in use.

data.name: Ce.ColumnsDefault
data.value: The default columns are in use.

data.name: Ce.ColumnsHelp
data.value: For dates, use yyyy-MM-dd (ISO 8601) unless your reporting body asks for another format, such as dd.MM.yyyy or MM/dd/yyyy; for hours, 0.##; for fixed text, choose Fixed text and type it. Leave a heading empty to remove the column.

data.name: Ce.Source.CeCourseNumberSuffix
data.value: CE / CPD activity number without prefix

data.name: Ce.Note.capce
data.value: For departments that are CAPCE-accredited providers: verified completions of your own CE courses. CAPCE does not publish its upload column order; the columns follow the data CAPCE requires, in its order, and can be changed.

data.name: Ce.Note.fl-ems
data.value: CE Broker's Easy Excel provider upload (columns A to H, no header row). Open the CSV in a spreadsheet and save it as an Excel workbook before uploading.

data.name: Ce.Note.va-ems
data.value: Virginia OEMS takes CE through its CE Scanner application and publishes no file layout, so this is a configurable CSV.

data.name: Ce.Note.nj-ems
data.value: New Jersey OEMS takes CE per student in NJLincs and publishes no file layout, so this is a configurable CSV.

data.name: Ce.Note.fl-fire
data.value: Florida's Bureau of Fire Standards and Training publishes no upload layout for training hours, so this is a configurable CSV.

data.name: Ce.Note.state-ce
data.value: A configurable CSV for any other US state's CE office.

data.name: Ce.Note.state-roster
data.value: A course completion roster with configurable columns for state systems such as Acadis, which publish no import template.

data.name: Ce.Problem.UnknownExporter
data.value: That file type is not known.

data.name: Ce.Problem.NotAuthorized
data.value: Only training officers can build CE files.

data.name: Ce.Problem.NoCapceProvider
data.value: Enter your CAPCE provider number in the settings below first.

data.name: Ce.Problem.NoCeBrokerProvider
data.value: Enter your CE Broker provider tracking number in the settings below first.

data.name: lms_ce_not_authorized
data.value: Only department administrators can change the CE reporting settings.

data.name: lms_ce_certification_type_invalid
data.value: Choose certification types of this department.

data.name: lms_ce_exporter_unknown
data.value: That file type is not known.

data.name: Ce.Exporter.training-hours
data.value: Training hours / CE / CPD file (any reporting body)

data.name: Ce.Note.training-hours
data.value: For any regulator, professional body, employer or insurer, in any country: one row per verified completion, dates as yyyy-MM-dd, hours with a full stop as the decimal separator, and headings in your language. Choose and order the columns your reporting body asks for.
